high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from BBC News, West Midlands, written by Chloe Hughes. The headline reads, "In pictures: city celebrates Ozzy Osbourne." The article is dated three hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The text describes a significant event where tens of thousands of people gathered in Birmingham, the hometown of Ozzy Osbourne, on Wednesday. They camped out for hours on Broad Street to catch a glimpse of his funeral procession as it made its way through the city.
